title: Vote on releasing Apache Iceberg 1.11.0 RC1
summary: This part of the 1.11.0 RC1 vote thread is about what should go into the next candidate. Aihua, the release manager, asked how critical a long-standing bug was and whether it should be added to the 1.11.0 milestone, and mentioned PR #15470. Huaxin answered that it is a correctness issue affecting readers such as Trino, Impala, Comet and iceberg-rust, but that it already exists in 1.10 and so is not a hard blocker. Steve Loughran said the SerializableFileIOWithSize fix in #16284 makes the file length more of an issue, especially for the GCS FileIO, but that #15470 was still stabilising and would be a risky last-minute patch. Kevin Liu agreed not to wait for it. Aihua reported that the last Spark backport, #16303, had merged and no blockers remained in the milestone, then announced RC4 for vote, RC2 and RC3 having been built but skipped as further backports and issues were found.

positions.stance: The bug is a correctness issue but exists in 1.10 already, so it is not a hard blocker for 1.11.0.
The #16284 fix makes file length matter more, notably for GCS FileIO, but #15470 is still stabilising and is a dangerous last-minute patch.
With the last Spark backport merged and no blockers left in the milestone, the release should move on to the next candidate without #15470, which is not a regression.
The release should not wait for #15470, with the final call left to the release manager.

outcome.note: RC1 was superseded: the release manager published RC4 for a new vote, after RC2 and RC3 were built but not put to a vote.

why_it_matters: Iceberg 1.11.0 went to RC4 without PR #15470, leaving a pre-existing correctness issue for a later release.
